items.title: 61529_Maxine Sullivan oral history interview
items.q: I think Ben Pollack probably played Pittsburgh and I probably met him there.

ctx.x: So that's when Benny went out and hired Fletcher Henderson and you know, arrangers there. Because they was really breathing down Benny's neck. I mean, Benny is the band leader, it was a good band. But we've been listening to some good music before we heard that broadcast. I know that Benny was with some bands before he got his own band, promoted him as the king of swing because we used to hear bands like Ben Pollack on the radio. In fact I think Ben Pollack probably played Pittsburgh and I probably met him there.
